core_idea: For owners of arts and sports academies, ClassLoop turns chasing parents for fees into fees that arrive on time, by linking attendance, parent updates and fee reminders in one flow.
alt: A student moves through four steps in order: attendance is marked, the parent is notified, a fee reminder goes out, and the fee is received with a receipt. Each step lights up as it happens.
sample_note: Sample students and batches, for illustration.

stages.label: Attendance marked
stages.caption: The coach marks the student present in one tap.

stages.label: Parent notified
stages.caption: The parent gets the update on WhatsApp.

stages.label: Fee reminder sent
stages.caption: The monthly fee reminder goes out on the due date.

stages.label: Fee received
stages.caption: The parent pays from the reminder.

done.label: Paid — the receipt is sent automatically.
